results.releaseNotes:
This is a whole new season of EA SPORTS FC™ Mobile! The 27 Season Update puts The World’s Game right in your hands! Shift the focus back to your club with game-changing tactical freedom, an intense squad-building challenge mode, and revolutionary PlayStyles designed to elevate your matchday experience. 
 
 NEW 27 FEATURES
 
GAME PLANS & DYNAMIC TACTICS
 Take full control of your team's tactical identity with the new Game Plan system.
 -In-Match Switching: Adapt on the fly by changing formations and mentalities dynamically mid-match.
 -5 Mentality Tiers: Fine-tune your strategy across Ultra Defensive, Defensive, Balanced, Attacking, and Ultra Attacking.
 -Custom Presets: Create and save up to 4 distinct Game Plans to switch between instantly during matches. 
 
GAUNTLET MODE
 Take on the FC Mobile Gauntlet through a series of challenging rounds that test your squad depth and tactical skills.
 - Each round features unique Match Objectives, Traits, and House Rules.
 - House Rules such as Hot Zone, Position Hero, and No Rules can also change how each match plays.
 - Strategic Squad Management: Player Items have limited appearances per run, forcing you to rotate your roster.
 -Progress through nodes, earn Stars, and unlock milestone Rewards. 
 
GAMEPLAY UPDATES
 Two new PlayStyles bring player abilities to life:
 - Incisive Through Pass: Thread through-balls with improved target selection and greater lead distance.
 - Dead Ball: Bend free kicks with increased curl, pace, dip, and precision.
 
AUDIO & VISUALS
 - Localized Matchday Energy: Feel the passion of the crowd with updated, immersive localized commentary in Mexican Spanish, Indonesian, and Thai. 
 - Signature Celebrations: Express your victories in style with brand-new iconic goal celebrations, including "Predator", "Flex", "Fist Pump", "Rockstar", and "Tuxedo"! 
 - Enjoy an overall visual refresh of the game in this new season update. 
 
 Play The World’s Game, anywhere.

This game includes optional in-game purchases of virtual currency that can be used to acquire virtual in-game items, including a random selection of virtual in-game items. 

Play EA SPORTS FC™ Mobile Football 27, the ultimate online football game on mobile. EA SPORTS FC™ Mobile 27 Update has arrived. Celebrate the 2026/2027 season of football, in an update inspired by the World's Game. 
 
Play a Quick Match as any team from the Premier League or LALIGA EA SPORTS including Liverpool & Real Madrid. Build your dream Football Ultimate Team™ with football stars Kylian Mbappé, Jude Bellingham, Bradley Barcola, Pedri or legendary ICONs like David Beckham, Ronaldinho, Zinedine Zidane & Zlatan Ibrahimović. FC Mobile has licenses for the world’s biggest football competitions, clubs & leagues. 
  
KEY 2027 FEATURES
Score Goals with the world’s best players 
Level up an Ultimate Team of football super stars
Play a Quick Match with Friends, playing as the club or national team of your choice
Compete in The World's Game national football tournament mode
Join a League & team up to compete in tournaments and collect more rewards
Rank Up in PvP football game modes including 1v1 H2H, VS Attack & Football Manager Mode
Earn Rewards faster with Daily Training, Quests and Achievements
Extra Time features football match content & the latest football match scores

THE WORLD’S GAME TOURNAMENT
Choose your national team and compete to become champions
Select from over 40 national teams including England, Spain, Portugal, Brazil & more
Score big goals with heroes from each nation
 
COMPETE IN HEAD TO HEAD PVP
Play PVP matches to rank up in Division Rivals 
Earn rewards as you climb weekly Leaderboards
Improved ranking system & enhanced matchmaking
 
JOIN LEAGUES, EARN REWARDS
Bigger Leagues! Join leagues with up to 100 members
Find friends faster with Leagues tagged by language, clubs, region & more
Team up with your league to play tournaments & earn seasonal rewards
 
AUTHENTIC GAMEPLAY IMPROVEMENTS
Game Plans: Play to win by swapping tactics mid-match 
Enhanced Passing System: Move the ball with improved precision & control assistance
Player Authenticity: More impactful attributes & skill moves based on their real world performance
 
QUICK MATCH WITH FRIENDS
Jump into a football game instantly with Quick Match
Choose your Club, National Team or your Ultimate Team
Invite friends for a fast football match & see who can score most
Compete as Real Madrid, Liverpool, Manchester City, Chelsea, & many more
 
FOOTBALL LEAGUES, LEGENDS & COMPETITIONS
Premier League, LALIGA EA SPORTS, UEFA Champions League UCL, Bundesliga, Ligue 1 McDonald’s, Serie A Enilive & many more are playable throughout the season
Relive ICONic moments with football’s greatest players: David Beckham, Ronaldinho, Zlatan Ibrahimović, Zinedine Zidane & more
 
Play the World's Game, Anywhere.

This app: Requires acceptance of EA’s User Agreement. EA’s Privacy & Cookie Policy applies. You consent to any personal data collected through your use of EA’s services being transferred to the United States, as further explained in the Privacy & Cookie Policy. Requires an Internet connection (network fees may apply). Contains direct links to the Internet and social networking sites intended for an audience over 13. Allows players (above the minimum age of digital consent in their country) to communicate via League chat; to disable for users under the age of majority with League chat access, use your device's parental controls.

FC Points purchase is not available in Belgium.
